What customers say

One of 478 Google reviews, 477 of them with five stars.

“Amazing experience! I felt welcomed and informed throughout the whole process. I’ve been pierced in several places in Norway before, but the quality of the work here and how well I was taken care of surpassed every experience I’ve had in Norway. He was professional, friendly, and very responsible. Before piercing, he showed me the placement multiple times to make sure I was completely happy with it. I got three piercings, and I really appreciated how much time and care he put into the process. In Norway I’ve often felt that piercings can be a bit rushed, but here it was the opposite. The studio is beautiful and located in very cozy surroundings, and the whole experience felt calm and thoughtful. This is not a place where you just get pierced in 10 minutes and leave, it’s a full experience. I would absolutely recommend it!”
